title: Varying Texture With Age
description: Change the texture of the plants so you can easily tell their age apart.
body:
# Description
This pack changes the texture of plants to make it easier to see how they grow. It also slightly changes the color of crops to make them easier to distinguish.

|Plant|Age|Color|
|------|---|-------|
|**Nether wart**|0|Yellow|
|      |1|Orange|
|      |2|Orange|
|      |3|Red|
||||
|**Pumpkin**|No|Orange|
||||
|**Melon**|No|Green|
